statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-19 on the Leantime v3.15.3 source and its locked dependencies. The finding is php-jwt accepting HMAC (HS256/384/512) keys shorter than the algorithm needs; 7.0.0, the only fix, enforces a minimum HMAC key length. Leantime never calls php-jwt itself (no Firebase\\JWT use in app/ or config/) and sets no JWT algorithm (no default_algorithm, no HS256/384/512). It arrives only through laravel/socialite v5.21.0 and socialiteproviders/microsoft 4.7.0, and both verify with RSA keys from the provider's key set: socialite's src/Two/FacebookProvider.php:119 decodes with the RS256 key built at :151-154, and Microsoft's Provider.php:355 decodes against JWK::parseKeySet of Microsoft's keys with default_algorithm RS256 (:325). No HMAC key is ever handed to php-jwt. Both packages require php-jwt ^6, so 7.0 cannot be installed. Revisit when they allow php-jwt 7 or Leantime uses HMAC JWTs.
